name: Certifications
excerpt: Certifications in project management include Prince2, PMP, and CAPM.
notes: Certifications in project management include Prince2 (UK/AU), PMP (USA, requiring 4500 hours of experience), and CAPM (requiring 1500 hours of experience or 23 hours of training). These certifications validate a project manager's expertise.
context_summary:
- Certifications include Prince2, PMP, and CAPM.
- PMP requires 4500 hours of experience.
- CAPM requires 1500 hours of experience or 23 hours of training.
- Certifications validate a project manager's expertise.
